name: Clumsy Apprentice deals 2 damage to your champion and draws a card on enter
notes: Clumsy Apprentice's element is FIRE, matching the starting champion, so no lineage patch is needed. Without a [Class Bonus] discount, the full 2-reserve cost is paid, then the unconditional On Enter effect resolves immediately with no opportunity-window PASS or target choice needed.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Deal 2 damage to your champion. Draw a card.
